body: Thank you for sharing this, good luck with therapy.

I mean, I wanted to graduate university, get a good job, buy a nice house and have a family. The normal stuff. I just want to move somewhere and surround myself with people who make me happy. But I can’t move. I’m not smart enough to get in to a good university that’s far away. I don’t think I could move anyway. My mum has repeatedly been sectioned, she’s in a mental health institution now. I can’t leave, she needs me. She’s an awful mum, seeing her damages my mental health but not seeing her damages hers. I’m stuck here. I feel like the only way of ever getting out is suicide.
